summary: Wise Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting repurchases of its Class A ordinary shares from 24–28 August 2026, executed through Goldman Sachs International. Aggregate purchases totaled 286,461 shares on Nasdaq/US venues and 512,074 shares on London venues, at weighted-average prices ranging from GBP 9.55 to GBP 9.92 and USD 13.07 to USD 13.36 per share. Repurchased shares are held in treasury. The buybacks form part of a share buyback program announced on July 21, 2026, under which Wise expects to repurchase up to £405 million (approximately $540 million) of shares. The program follows UK Market Abuse Regulation and FCA Listing Rule disclosure requirements. Watch for continued periodic repurchase disclosures pacing toward the program's aggregate ceiling.
